label: Frontline
typical_people: operators, technicians, fitters, crews, security staff
controls: how the task is done today
needs: practical warning signs, what to stop and ask

label: First-line supervisors
typical_people: shift in-charges, maintenance supervisors, permit issuers, signatories
controls: which work starts, which work is accepted
needs: checks, hold points, what to refuse

label: Function managers
typical_people: maintenance, operations, engineering, integrity, HSE managers
controls: procedures, resources, priorities in a department

label: Site / asset leadership
typical_people: plant manager, head of operations, site leadership team

label: Top management
typical_people: CEO, ExCo, corporate HSE, corporate functions
needs: enterprise-wide transfer, policy and investment decisions

label: Board
typical_people: board, board safety / risk committee, independent directors

label: Auditors and assurance
typical_people: internal audit, certification bodies, regulators' inspectors, insurers
needs: test points, evidence to request, sampling

label: Investigators and HSE professionals
typical_people: incident investigators, HSE advisers, process safety engineers
needs: evidence gaps, key questions, interviews, method lessons

label: Emergency response and fire services
typical_people: fire crews, emergency planners, incident commanders

label: Engineering and integrity
typical_people: design, MOC, document control, integrity, reliability

label: Workforce representatives
typical_people: safety committee members, union safety reps

label: Enterprise risk management
typical_people: ERM leads, risk owners, insurers' risk engineers
controls: the risk register, bow-ties, control ratings, risk acceptance and key risk indicators
needs: proposed risk-register and bow-tie changes with the evidence behind each, for the risk owner to assess

label: HR and workforce planning
typical_people: HR business partners, workforce planners, rostering and fatigue owners, competence-framework owners
controls: selection and staffing standards, role qualifications, crew composition, rosters and workload
needs: system learnings on selection, qualification and manning, and the competence framework to change

label: Session leaders
typical_people: supervisors, shift in-charges and trainers who lead a short safety moment or shift-start session
controls: what a crew hears, discusses and practises in a ten-minute session
needs: a short deck and poster: what happened, did you know, what you can do, questions to ask the crew

label: Leaders and peer support after an incident
typical_people: site and line leaders who respond to the people involved, peer supporters, employee-assistance and occupational-health contacts
controls: how the organisation responds to the people involved: who is asked what they need, the support offered and the system conditions put right
needs: Dekker's restorative questions as questions to ask, the organisation's obligations and second-victim support, never an account of a person

label: Sister-site HSE
typical_people: HSE managers and advisers at the organisation's other sites, site process safety leads
controls: their own site's self-assessment, the conditions they check for and the site's response
needs: one self-check per transferable learning: the condition to look for, what to check and where, for their site to answer

label: Other sites and peer organisations
typical_people: HSE leads, operations and maintenance managers and their crews at the organisation's other sites; peer operators in the same industry
controls: the same equipment, procedures and work at their own sites, and how fast they check for the same conditions
needs: a short alert: what happened, why it matters to them, the priority-1 learnings and what to check now
